_meta.purpose: Seed config for PDF/document discovery. Entry points are support/download portals, NOT product marketing pages. Feed these to a doc-discovery stage alongside the existing product-page discovery.

authority_levels.1: tech_data_sheet / dimensional_drawing / mount_or_compatibility_note — authoritative, extract to structured specs
authority_levels.2: user_manual / operation_guide — authoritative, dense, good for edge cases (power draw, media, metadata protocols)
authority_levels.3: firmware_release_notes / white_paper — authoritative for behavior changes over time
authority_levels.4: brochure / catalog — partial specs, marketing framing; embed but do not treat as spec source of truth

_meta.verified: 2026-07-30 via web search; entries marked verify_url=true need a manual check before scraping
_meta.etiquette: Respect robots.txt, keep existing delay_min/delay_max patterns, cache aggressively, dedupe by sha256 before parsing
